units.rawText: In the past, I was so impatient to grow up that I caused the tragedy of the Operand Black Hole. I didn't just cause everyone huge trouble—I even hurt the most important person to me...

units.rawText: But thanks to your help and Sister Persicaria's, I'm able to stand here now. I'm still immature, and I can't perfectly control this power yet...

units.rawText: But this time, I definitely won't rush. I'll keep my feet on the ground and, step by step, use my own strength to become Neumann... No, to become someone who can help everyone—the perfect child in everyone's hearts.
